This tutorial teaches you how to evaluate the health information you find on the Internet. The tutorial has five sections. Use the navigation bar at the top and the arrows on each page to go forward or backward. You can use this tutorial on our Web site or download Evaluating Internet Health Information: A Tutorial (PDF, 3.6 MB). You can download a checklist for Evaluating Internet Health Information (PDF, 169 KB) to help you remember what to look for when you look at health information. These two examples of websites were made-up for this tutorial. But they show different ways that content may be arranged.
